parts.name: Translation Panel 1
parts.Basic_description: This is one of the sliding glass panels of the window, made primarily of glass with a supporting aluminum or PVC frame.
parts.Functional_description: It allows light to pass through and can slide horizontally to open or close the window for ventilation.
parts.Movement_description: It moves horizontally along the track within the window frame.

parts.name: Translation Panel 2
parts.Basic_description: This is the second sliding glass panel of the window, similar in structure to the first panel.
parts.Functional_description: It works in conjunction with the first panel to open or close the window, providing adjustable airflow and access.
parts.Movement_description: It slides horizontally in the opposite direction of the first panel.

parts.name: Translation Panel 3
parts.Basic_description: This is an additional sliding glass panel, part of the window’s movable section.
parts.Functional_description: It provides an additional layer of movement or coverage, enhancing ventilation control and insulation.
parts.Movement_description: It slides horizontally within the same track system as the other panels.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main frame of the sliding window, made of aluminum for strength and durability.
parts.Functional_description: It supports and guides the sliding panels, providing structural integrity and alignment for smooth operation.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the fixed base for the sliding components.
